concepts.title: The Postal System as Carrier of Words
concepts.definition: The chapter presents the postal system as the great carrier of words: letters, messages and news travel between people who are far apart, and the post connects hearts and homes long before phones and the internet.
concepts.key_idea: Before wires and waves, the postman walked - carrying words that bound people together.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe107.txt sections on the postal system (carrier of words)
question_patterns: why is the postal system called the carrier of words
how did letters reach their destinations in earlier times
what role did the postman play in villages and towns
compare letter writing with messaging today
what kinds of things travel by post - list them
why do people still value handwritten letters - discuss

solution_steps.explain: A letter moves from writer to post office to postman to reader.
The post carries feelings, news and official words alike.
Distance shrinks when words travel reliably.

concepts.title: Postal History and the Indian Context
concepts.definition: The text contrasts older courier traditions with the British postal system set up in India, tracing how a organised network of post offices, stamps and postmen grew into one of the widest communication networks of the country.
concepts.key_idea: From runners and daks to post offices: the Indian post grew into a nationwide network.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe107.txt historical sections on the post in India
question_patterns: how was mail carried in India before the British postal system
what changes did the organised postal system bring
what is the role of the post office in rural India
why are postage stamps important - discuss
describe the journey of a letter through the postal network
how has the postal service adapted to modern times

solution_steps.explain: Messengers and dak runners carried words before the network.
Uniform postage, stamps and offices standardised the service.
The post office now serves banking, savings and delivery too.

concepts.title: Informational Text Features and the Theme of Connection
concepts.definition: As an informational text, the chapter uses columns, examples and explanation to build understanding; its deeper theme is connection - words carried faithfully turn strangers into correspondents and distance into intimacy.
concepts.key_idea: Faithful carriage of words is faithful carriage of feelings - connection is the theme.
concepts.textbook_ref: iebe107.txt text features and concluding theme
question_patterns: what features make this an informational text - list them

solution_steps.explain: Facts, structure and explanation mark informational writing.
Columns and examples organise the information clearly.
Beyond information, the post delivers connection.
